chunks: The trustworthy Shaykh Abū al-Faraj al-Muẓaffar ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Ḥamdānī was among the envoys of Imam al-Ḥujjah, may Allah hasten his relief.

key_terms.ٱلْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the divinely designated leader
key_terms.ٱلْحَمْدَانِيُّ: belonging to the Ḥamdānī lineage or affiliation
key_terms.ٱلْحُجَّةِ: al-Ḥujjah, a title of the Imam meaning the divine proof

ai.seo_question: Who was Abū al-Faraj al-Muẓaffar al-Ḥamdānī and what was his connection to Imam al-Ḥujjah?
ai.summary: This passage is a brief biographical notice identifying Abū al-Faraj al-Muẓaffar ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Ḥamdānī as a trustworthy Shaykh. It also states that he was among the envoys of Imam al-Ḥujjah, highlighting his recognized role and standing in relation to the Imam عليه السلام.
